_comment: Evolution on SimScale, STEP air-volume route (simscale_step_eval.py). Keys: export SIMSCALE_API_KEYS='k1,k2,...' (never in a file in the repo). Each key runs at most runs_per_key cars, then the next key is used; when all are used the campaign waits (`python campaign.py tick <dir>` reports it). Every car goes through the same route (simscale_step_domain.build_design): the team's exact CAD outside the sidepod region, the pod as ~4500 triangles, seam 0.3 mm off the region, exact wheels, road 0.15 mm under the wheels. The winners are re-timed in our OpenFOAM pipeline on GitHub Actions (stage recheck).
_rules: Design rules (CarSpec switches): no virtual cargo; nothing in the sidepod region above 27.175 mm (the team STEP's sidepod top; also used for the T4.4.2 halo cap, which the STEP itself reaches); milled from top and bottom only (3.175 mm ball); 3 mm minimum walls; no loose pieces; sidepod region only.
_comment_sigma: sigma halved from 1.0 to 0.5 after generation 1 (its designs were lumpy); the running CMA state was rescaled to match
